<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Testing: Interview Prep</title>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Atkinson+Hyperlegible+Next:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,700;1,400&family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,500..800&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&family=Caveat:wght@600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  /* study-theme v4 "whiteboard": the one stylesheet every guide uses. Edit here, then run
     `npm run study:upgrade` to apply it to every guide (lib.upgrade swaps each guide's <style> for this file).
     Token names are also used inside the SVG diagrams (dg*.mjs), so rename none of them. */
  :root{
    /* light: a whiteboard. Navy ink, blue marker for actions, green for done, yellow highlighter. */
    --bg:#F5F7FA;
    --panel:#FFFFFF;
    --panel-2:#EEF2F7;
    --border:#D3DAE5;
    --text:#14213D;
    --muted:#4F5D78;
    --accent:#1B55C5;
    --accent-ink:#FFFFFF;
    --accent-soft:#E4EDFC;
    --gold:#7A5200;
    --gold-soft:#FFF1B8;
    --ok:#126B4B;
    --ok-soft:#DDF3E9;
    --code-bg:#EEF2F7;
    --danger:#B42318;
    --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,33,61,.06), 0 4px 14px rgba(20,33,61,.04);
    --mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
    --sans: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    --display: 'Bricolage Grotesque', var(--sans);
    --hand: 'Caveat', 'Segoe Print', 'Bradley Hand', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive;
    --measure: 76ch;
  }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
    :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
      /* dark: a chalkboard. Chalk white text, chalk blue / yellow / green accents. */
      --bg:#101A19;
      --panel:#17231F;
      --panel-2:#1E2D29;
      --border:#33493F;
      --text:#ECF1EE;
      --muted:#A9B8B1;
      --accent:#93BCFF;
      --accent-ink:#0A1730;
      --accent-soft:#1D3048;
      --gold:#F0CF6B;
      --gold-soft:#3A3216;
      --ok:#7FD6A8;
      --ok-soft:#173327;
      --code-bg:#0C1513;
      --danger:#F5A99C;
      --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
    }
  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"]{
    --bg:#101A19;
    --panel:#17231F;
    --panel-2:#1E2D29;
    --border:#33493F;
    --text:#ECF1EE;
    --muted:#A9B8B1;
    --accent:#93BCFF;
    --accent-ink:#0A1730;
    --accent-soft:#1D3048;
    --gold:#F0CF6B;
    --gold-soft:#3A3216;
    --ok:#7FD6A8;
    --ok-soft:#173327;
    --code-bg:#0C1513;
    --danger:#F5A99C;
    --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
  }

  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;}
  html{color-scheme:light dark; scroll-padding-top:16px;}
  body{
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--text);
    font-family:var(--sans);
    font-size:16px;
    line-height:1.6;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
    text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
  }
  a{color:var(--accent); text-underline-offset:2px;}
  :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; border-radius:4px;}
  ::selection{background:var(--gold-soft); color:var(--text);}

  .app{display:flex; min-height:100vh;}

  /* ---------- Sidebar ---------- */
  .sidebar{
    width:288px;
    flex:0 0 288px;
    border-right:1px solid var(--border);
    background:var(--panel);
    padding:18px 14px 24px;
    position:sticky;
    top:0;
    height:100vh;
    overflow-y:auto;
    scrollbar-width:thin;
  }
  .side-top{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; margin:0 0 14px;}
  .home-link{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; color:var(--muted); text-decoration:none; padding:6px 8px; border-radius:8px;}
  .home-link:hover{color:var(--accent); background:var(--accent-soft);}
  .theme-btn{font:inherit; font-size:15px; line-height:1; width:34px; height:34px; color:var(--muted); background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer;}
  .theme-btn:hover{color:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent);}
  .brand{
    font-size:13.5px;
    line-height:1.45;
    color:var(--muted);
    padding:0 8px 16px;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
    margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .brand b{display:block; font-family:var(--display); font-size:19px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.01em; color:var(--text);}
  .brand br{display:none;}
  .nav-item{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;
    gap:10px;
    width:100%;
    text-align:left;
    padding:9px 10px;
    border-radius:9px;
    border:1px solid transparent;
    background:transparent;
    color:var(--text);
    font-family:var(--sans);
    font-size:15px;
    line-height:1.35;
    cursor:pointer;
    margin-bottom:2px;
  }
  .nav-item:hover{background:var(--panel-2);}
  .nav-item.active{background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--text); font-weight:700; box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent);}
  .nav-num{font-size:12.5px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:var(--muted); width:20px; flex:0 0 20px;}
  .nav-item.active .nav-num{color:var(--accent);}
  .nav-label{flex:1;}
  .nav-count{
    font-size:12px;
    font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
    color:var(--muted);
    background:var(--panel-2);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    padding:1px 7px;
    border-radius:999px;
  }
  .nav-item.complete .nav-count{color:var(--ok); border-color:var(--ok); background:var(--ok-soft);}
  .progress-box{
    margin-top:20px;
    padding:14px 12px;
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:12px;
    background:var(--panel-2);
  }
  .progress-box .label{font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:8px; text-transform:lowercase;}
  .progress-box .label::first-letter{text-transform:uppercase;}
  .progress-track{height:8px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--border); overflow:hidden;}
  .progress-fill{height:100%; background:var(--ok); width:0%; transition:width .25s ease;}
  .progress-num{margin-top:8px; font-size:13.5px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:var(--text);}
  .reset-btn{
    margin-top:10px;
    width:100%;
    font-family:var(--sans);
    font-size:13px;
    color:var(--muted);
    background:transparent;
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:8px;
    padding:7px 8px;
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .reset-btn:hover{color:var(--danger);border-color:var(--danger);}

  /* ---------- Main ---------- */
  .main{
    flex:1;
    min-width:0;
    padding:40px 48px 96px;
    max-width:1080px;
  }
  .hero{margin-bottom:36px;}
  .hero .eyebrow-free{display:none;}
  .hero h1{
    font-family:var(--display);
    font-size:clamp(28px, 3.4vw, 40px);
    line-height:1.12;
    margin:0 0 14px;
    font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:-0.02em;
    text-wrap:balance;
  }
  .hero p{color:var(--muted); max-width:68ch; margin:0 0 6px; font-size:16.5px;}
  .hero p strong{color:var(--text);}
  .hero .source-note{font-size:13.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:18px; line-height:1.9;}

  .section-head{
    display:flex;
    align-items:baseline;
    gap:12px;
    margin:44px 0 14px;
    padding-bottom:12px;
    border-bottom:2px solid var(--text);
  }
  .section-head .num{font-family:var(--display); color:var(--accent); font-size:17px; font-weight:700; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
  .section-head h2{font-family:var(--display); font-size:26px; line-height:1.2; margin:0; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.015em;}
  .section-head .count{margin-left:auto; font-size:13.5px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:var(--muted); white-space:nowrap;}

  .qcard{
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:14px;
    background:var(--panel);
    margin-bottom:10px;
    overflow:hidden;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  }
  .qcard:hover{border-color:var(--accent);}
  .qcard.open{border-color:var(--accent); box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 var(--accent), var(--shadow);}
  .qcard.focused{outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:1px;}
  .qhead{
    display:flex;
    align-items:flex-start;
    gap:14px;
    padding:15px 18px;
    cursor:pointer;
    user-select:none;
  }
  .qcheck{
    margin-top:3px;
    flex:0 0 auto;
    width:20px;height:20px;
    border-radius:6px;
    border:1.5px solid var(--muted);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    cursor:pointer;
    background:var(--panel);
  }
  .qcheck:hover{border-color:var(--ok);}
  .qcheck.done{background:var(--ok); border-color:var(--ok);}
  .qcheck.done::after{content:"✓"; color:var(--panel); font-size:13px; font-weight:700;}
  .qmain{flex:1; min-width:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px;}
  .qtext{flex:1; font-size:16.5px; line-height:1.4; font-weight:700;}
  .qtext.done-text{color:var(--muted); font-weight:500;}
  .qchips{display:flex; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .qsec,.qcore{font-size:12px; padding:1px 8px; border-radius:99px; border:1px solid var(--border); color:var(--muted); background:var(--panel-2);}
  .qcore{color:var(--gold); border-color:var(--gold); background:var(--gold-soft);}
  .qsum{font-size:14.5px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.5; max-width:var(--measure);}
  .qcard.open .qsum{display:none;}
  .qchevron{
    flex:0 0 auto;
    color:var(--muted);
    font-size:20px;
    line-height:1;
    transform:rotate(0deg);
    transition:transform .15s ease;
    margin-top:2px;
  }
  .qcard.open .qchevron{transform:rotate(90deg); color:var(--accent);}
  .qbody{
    display:none;
    padding:2px 22px 22px 52px;
    border-top:1px solid var(--border);
    font-size:16px;
    line-height:1.65;
  }
  .qcard.open .qbody{display:block; padding-top:18px;}
  /* Prose keeps a readable line length; tables, code and diagrams may use the full card width. */
  .qbody > p, .qbody > ul, .qbody > ol, .qbody > blockquote, .qbody > .callout, .qbody > h3, .qbody > h4{max-width:var(--measure);}
  .qbody p{margin:0 0 14px;}
  .qbody ul, .qbody ol{margin:0 0 14px; padding-left:22px;}
  .qbody li{margin-bottom:7px;}
  .qbody li::marker{color:var(--accent);}
  .qbody strong{color:var(--text); font-weight:700;}
  .qbody h3, .qbody h4{font-family:var(--display); font-size:17px; margin:20px 0 8px; letter-spacing:-0.01em;}
  code{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    background:var(--code-bg);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    padding:0 5px;
    border-radius:5px;
    font-size:0.875em;
    overflow-wrap:anywhere;
  }
  pre{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    background:var(--code-bg);
    color:var(--text);
    padding:14px 16px;
    border-radius:10px;
    overflow-x:auto;
    font-size:13.5px;
    line-height:1.65;
    margin:0 0 16px;
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    tab-size:2;
  }
  pre code{background:none; border:0; padding:0; font-size:inherit;}
  /* syntax colouring added by the engine (comments, strings, keywords, numbers) */
  .tk-c{color:var(--muted); font-style:italic;}
  .tk-s{color:var(--ok);}
  .tk-k{color:var(--accent); font-weight:500;}
  .tk-n{color:var(--gold);}
  /* A diagram is a whiteboard (a chalkboard in dark mode): engine.js redraws the tidy SVG by hand
     (see "sketch" there) and this sets the board, the marker strokes and the handwriting. */
  .diagram{
    background:var(--panel);
    border:1.5px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:14px;
    box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 4px var(--panel), inset 0 0 0 5px var(--panel-2);
    padding:16px;
    margin:0 0 16px;
    overflow-x:auto;
  }
  .diagram svg{display:block; margin:0 auto; max-width:100%; height:auto;}
  /* Handwriting is sized by x-height (font-size-adjust) so it reads as large as the type it replaces.
     These values are the largest at which every label in every guide still fits its box:
     `node scripts/study/audit-diagrams.mjs` proves it, so re-run that after changing them. */
  .diagram svg.sk text:not(.sk-code){font-family:var(--hand); font-size-adjust:.50; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.012em;}
  .diagram svg.sk text[font-family="var(--mono)"]:not(.sk-code){font-size-adjust:.60;}
  .diagram svg.sk text.sk-caps:not(.sk-code){font-size-adjust:.44;}
  .diagram svg.sk text[font-weight="600"]:not(.sk-code), .diagram svg.sk text[font-weight="700"]:not(.sk-code){font-weight:700;}
  /* Code and SQL are never handwritten (engine.js sketchIsCode): .sk-code keeps the authored type. */
  .diagram svg.sk .sk-s{stroke-width:1.9px; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference){
    .diagram svg.sk .sk-d{animation:sk-draw .5s ease-out backwards; animation-delay:var(--d, 0ms);}
    .diagram svg.sk .sk-t{animation:sk-ink .35s ease-out backwards; animation-delay:var(--d, 0ms);}
  }
  @keyframes sk-draw{ from{stroke-dasharray:1; stroke-dashoffset:1; fill-opacity:0;} to{stroke-dasharray:1; stroke-dashoffset:0;} }
  @keyframes sk-ink{ from{opacity:0;} }
  /* The tidy original stays one click away (the switch under each diagram), drawn exactly as authored. */
  .diagram.tidy{background:var(--panel-2); border-width:1px; border-radius:12px; box-shadow:none;}
  .dg-bar{display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap:4px; margin:10px 0 -4px; position:sticky; left:0;}
  .dg-bar button{
    font:500 11.5px/1 var(--sans); color:var(--muted); background:transparent; cursor:pointer;
    border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:999px; padding:5px 9px;
  }
  .dg-bar button:hover{color:var(--text); border-color:var(--border);}
  .dg-bar button[aria-pressed="true"]{color:var(--accent); background:var(--accent-soft); border-color:transparent;}
  .dg-bar button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:1px;}
  .dg-bar button[data-dg="zoom"]{margin-left:6px; border-color:var(--border);}
  /* On a phone a 900-unit drawing squeezed into 300px is unreadable, so it keeps a readable size
     and scrolls sideways inside its board instead. */
  @media (max-width:760px){ .diagram svg{min-width:680px;} }
  /* Enlarged view (engine.js enlargeDiagram) */
  .dg-zoom{
    width:min(1500px, calc(100vw - 24px)); max-width:none; max-height:calc(100vh - 24px); padding:0;
    border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:16px; background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); overflow:hidden;
  }
  .dg-zoom[open]{display:flex; flex-direction:column;}
  .dg-zoom::backdrop{background:rgba(10,16,30,.6);}
  .dg-zoom-top{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; padding:8px 10px 8px 16px;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); font:500 12.5px/1.3 var(--sans); color:var(--muted);
  }
  .dg-zoom-close{
    font:600 13px/1 var(--sans); color:var(--text); background:var(--panel); cursor:pointer;
    border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:999px; padding:9px 14px;
  }
  .dg-zoom-close:hover{border-color:var(--accent); color:var(--accent);}
  .dg-zoom-close:focus-visible, .dg-zoom-body:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:-2px;}
  .dg-zoom-body{overflow:auto; padding:14px;}
  .dg-zoom .diagram{margin:0;}
  .dg-zoom .diagram svg{width:100%; min-width:860px; max-width:none;}
  .dg-zoom .dg-bar [data-dg="zoom"]{display:none;}
  .diagram.lightbg{background:#F8FAFC; border-color:#CBD5E1;}
  .diagram.lightbg .codelabel{color:#334155;}
  .tag{
    display:inline-block;
    font-size:12px;
    color:var(--gold);
    background:var(--gold-soft);
    border:1px solid var(--gold);
    border-radius:6px;
    padding:1px 7px;
    margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .tscroll{overflow-x:auto; margin:0 0 16px;}
  .tscroll > table.cmp{margin:0;}
  table.cmp{
    width:100%;
    border-collapse:collapse;
    margin:0 0 16px;
    font-size:14.5px;
    line-height:1.5;
  }
  table.cmp th, table.cmp td{
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    padding:9px 12px;
    text-align:left;
    vertical-align:top;
  }
  table.cmp th{background:var(--panel-2); font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700;}
  table.cmp tr:nth-child(odd) td{background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel-2) 45%, transparent);}

  .tbadge{display:inline-block; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; color:var(--gold); background:var(--gold-soft); border:1px solid var(--gold); border-radius:99px; padding:2px 10px; margin-bottom:10px;}
  .deeper{margin-top:16px; padding-top:12px; border-top:1px dashed var(--border); font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.9;}
  .deeper + .deeper{margin-top:2px; padding-top:0; border-top:0;}
  a.go{color:var(--accent); text-decoration:none; border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent);}
  a.go:hover{border-bottom-color:var(--accent);}

  .search{width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; margin:0 0 14px; padding:10px 12px; font:inherit; font-size:14.5px; color:var(--text); background:var(--bg); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px;}
  .search::placeholder{color:var(--muted);}
  .search:focus{outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:1px;}
  .qcheck:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px;}
  mark{background:var(--gold-soft); color:var(--text); border-radius:3px; padding:0 2px;}
  .toolbar{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:10px 16px; margin:0 0 18px; font-size:14px; color:var(--muted);}
  .toolbar .tmeta{font-size:13.5px; margin-right:auto;}
  .toolbar .tgroup{display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .toolbar button{font:inherit; font-size:13.5px; color:var(--text); background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; padding:6px 12px; cursor:pointer;}
  .toolbar button:hover{border-color:var(--accent); color:var(--accent);}
  .toolbar label{display:flex; gap:6px; align-items:center; cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap;}
  .toolbar input{accent-color:var(--accent); width:15px; height:15px;}
  .empty{color:var(--muted); font-size:15px; padding:18px; border:1px dashed var(--border); border-radius:12px;}
  .pager{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; margin-top:28px;}
  .pager button{font:inherit; font-size:14.5px; font-weight:500; color:var(--accent); background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; padding:12px 16px; cursor:pointer; max-width:48%; text-align:left;}
  .pager button:last-child{text-align:right;}
  .pager button:hover{border-color:var(--accent); background:var(--accent-soft);}
  .back-btn{position:fixed; right:22px; bottom:22px; z-index:10; font:inherit; font-size:14px; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent-ink); background:var(--accent); border:0; border-radius:99px; padding:11px 18px; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.22);}
  .keys{display:inline-block; margin-top:6px;}
  kbd{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11.5px; padding:0 5px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-bottom-width:2px; border-radius:5px; background:var(--panel); color:var(--text);}
  .hero-actions{margin-top:18px; display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px;}
  .fc-start,.toolbar .flash-btn{font:inherit; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent-ink); background:var(--accent); border:1px solid var(--accent); border-radius:10px; cursor:pointer;}
  .fc-start{font-size:15px; padding:10px 18px;}
  .toolbar .flash-btn{color:var(--accent-ink);}
  .toolbar .flash-btn:hover{color:var(--accent-ink);}
  .fc-start:hover,.toolbar .flash-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.1);}
  button.fc-start.alt{background:var(--panel); color:var(--accent); border:1px solid var(--accent);}
  button.fc-start.alt:hover{background:var(--accent-soft); filter:none;}
  a.fc-start.alt{display:inline-block; text-decoration:none; background:var(--panel); color:var(--accent); border:1px solid var(--accent);}

  /* ---------- Flashcards ---------- */
  body.fc-lock{overflow:hidden;}
  .fc{position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:50; background:rgba(8,14,26,.6); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:24px;}
  .fc[hidden]{display:none;}
  .fc-dialog{width:min(920px,100%); max-height:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:18px; box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.4); outline:none;}
  .fc-head{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px; padding:18px 22px 12px;}

      q:"What does a good unit test look like?",
      a:`<p>Arrange, act, assert. One reason to fail. A name that states the behaviour, so a failure reads like a bug report.</p><p class="codelabel">A unit test (passes)</p><pre>import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest';
import { applyDiscount } from '../src/pricing';

describe('applyDiscount', () => {
  test('takes 10% off with the SAVE10 code', () => {
    // arrange
    const total = 1000;
    // act
    const result = applyDiscount(total, 'SAVE10');
    // assert
    expect(result).toBe(900);
  });

  test('rejects a fractional amount', () => {
    expect(() => applyDiscount(10.5, 'SAVE10')).toThrow(RangeError);
  });
});</pre><ul><li><strong>Name it by behaviour:</strong> “takes 10% off with the SAVE10 code”, not “test1” or “works”.</li><li><strong>One concept per test.</strong> Several assertions are fine if they describe one outcome.</li><li><strong>No logic in tests:</strong> no loops or conditionals that could hide a bug in the test itself.</li><li><strong>Test the edges:</strong> zero, empty, the largest value, invalid input.</li></ul>`
    },

      q:"How do you mock a function, a module and a timer?",
      a:`<p class="codelabel">vi.fn, vi.spyOn and fake timers (all pass)</p><pre>import { expect, test, vi } from 'vitest';
import { welcome, mailer } from '../src/notify';

test('vi.fn records calls', () => {
  const onSave = vi.fn();
  [1, 2].forEach(onSave);
  expect(onSave).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  expect(onSave).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, 1, 0, [1, 2]);   // forEach passes value, index, array
});

test('vi.spyOn replaces one method and can be restored', async () => {
  const send = vi.spyOn(mailer, 'send').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
  await expect(welcome({ email: 'ada@example.com' })).resolves.toBe('sent');
  expect(send).toHaveBeenCalledWith('ada@example.com', 'Welcome');
  send.mockRestore();
});

test('fake timers move time forward without waiting', () => {
  vi.useFakeTimers();
  const fn = vi.fn();
  setTimeout(fn, 5000);
  vi.advanceTimersByTime(4999);
  expect(fn).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  vi.advanceTimersByTime(1);
  expect(fn).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  vi.useRealTimers();
});</pre><p>For a whole module, <code>vi.mock("./module")</code> replaces every export; it is hoisted to the top of the file, so it takes effect before imports run. Prefer replacing a <strong>dependency you pass in</strong> over mocking a module, because that needs no mocking tool at all.</p><p><strong>Trap:</strong> Restore what you change (<code>mockRestore</code>, <code>vi.useRealTimers</code>).   await expect(fail()).rejects.toThrow('boom');
});</pre><ul><li><strong>Always <code>await</code> or <code>return</code> the promise.</strong> Without it, the test finishes before the assertion runs and passes whatever happens.</li><li>Use <code>await expect(...).rejects</code> or <code>resolves</code> for promises, not a <code>try/catch</code> that can pass silently.</li><li>For code that waits (debounce, retry), use fake timers instead of real waiting.</li></ul><p><strong>Trap:</strong> A missing <code>await</code> in front of an assertion on a promise makes the test pass even when the promise would fail.       a:`<p><strong>The more your tests resemble the way your software is used, the more confidence they can give you.</strong> RTL renders your component into a real DOM and gives you queries that find things the way a user or a screen reader would: by role, label and text.</p><ul><li>Do not reach into component state, instances or hooks. Click, type, and look at the screen.</li><li>Because the tests describe behaviour, a refactor from <code>useState</code> to a reducer does not break them.</li><li>Accessibility comes for free: if <code>getByRole("button", { name: "Save" })</code> works, the button has the right role and name.</li></ul><div class="callout"><strong>Say it like this:</strong> I test components the way a person uses them: find by role or label, interact with user-event, and assert on what is visible.</div>`

    {
      q:"`userEvent` or `fireEvent`?",
      a:`<p><code>fireEvent</code> dispatches <strong>one</strong> DOM event. <code>userEvent</code> simulates what a user does, which is <strong>several</strong> events: typing a character fires keydown, keypress, input and keyup; clicking moves the pointer, presses, releases and clicks, and checks the element is not disabled or hidden.</p><p class="codelabel">Always await user-event calls</p><pre>const user = userEvent.setup();          // create one per test
await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Email'), 'ada@example.com');
await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in' }));</pre><ul><li>Prefer <code>userEvent</code>: it catches bugs such as a click on a disabled button doing nothing.</li><li>Call <code>userEvent.setup()</code> before rendering, and <code>await</code> every interaction.</li><li>Use <code>fireEvent</code> only for events a user cannot produce directly, such as a scroll or a custom event.</li></ul>`

    {
      q:"How do you test a form?",
      a:`<p>Test the behaviour the user sees: invalid input shows messages and does not submit; valid input submits the right values; a server error is shown.</p><p class="codelabel">Two form tests (both pass)</p><pre>test('shows validation messages and does not submit an invalid form', async () => {
  const user = userEvent.setup();
  const onSubmit = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined);
  render(<LoginForm onSubmit={onSubmit} />);

  await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Email'), 'not-an-email');
  await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Password'), 'short');
  await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in' }));

  expect(await screen.findByText('Enter a valid email address')).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(screen.getByText('Password must be at least 8 characters')).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(onSubmit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
});

  const user = userEvent.setup();
  const onSubmit = vi.fn().mockRejectedValue(new Error('Wrong email or password'));
  render(<LoginForm onSubmit={onSubmit} />);

  await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Email'), 'ada@example.com');
  await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Password'), 'correct-horse');
  await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in' }));

  expect(onSubmit).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ email: 'ada@example.com', password: 'correct-horse' });
  expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toHaveTextContent('Wrong email or password');
});</pre><p>Here the only thing replaced is the <code>onSubmit</code> prop: the form, its validation and its error display all run for real.</p>`

    {
      q:"How do you test UI that appears asynchronously?",
      a:`<p class="codelabel">Waiting for content (both pass)</p><pre>test('findBy waits for content that arrives after a fetch', async () => {
  render(<UserList />);
  expect(screen.getByText('Loading users…')).toBeInTheDocument();     // there immediately
  expect(await screen.findByText('Ada')).toBeInTheDocument();         // appears after the response
});

test('waitFor retries an assertion until it passes', async () => {
  render(<UserList />);
  await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText('Ada')).toBeInTheDocument());
});</pre><ul><li><strong><code>findBy</code></strong> is a <code>getBy</code> that retries until the element appears or a timeout (one second by default) passes. Prefer it for “wait for this to appear”.</li><li><strong><code>waitFor</code></strong> retries any callback until it stops throwing. Use it for assertions that are not about one element appearing.</li><li><strong><code>act</code></strong> makes React apply updates before you assert. RTL wraps its helpers in it for you, so you rarely write it by hand (only around direct state changes, such as advancing fake timers).</li><li>Never put a side effect such as a click inside <code>waitFor</code>: it can run many times.</li></ul>`

      q:"How do you test a custom hook, and a component that needs providers?",
      a:`<p class="codelabel">A wrapper and renderHook (both pass)</p><pre>test('a custom wrapper supplies providers', () => {
  render(<ThemeBadge />, { wrapper: ({ children }) => <ThemeProvider value="dark">{children}</ThemeProvider> });
  expect(screen.getByText('Theme: dark')).toBeInTheDocument();
});

  vi.useFakeTimers();

  rerender({ v: 'ab' });
  expect(result.current).toBe('a');                       // not updated yet
  act(() => { vi.advanceTimersByTime(300); });
  expect(result.current).toBe('ab');
  vi.useRealTimers();
});</pre><ul><li>Put providers (theme, router, query client) in a <strong>wrapper</strong> and share it as a custom <code>render</code>, so each test does not repeat them.</li><li>Test a hook through <code>renderHook</code> only when it is reusable on its own.       q:"How do you test an HTTP API in Node.js?",
      a:`<p>Build the app from a <strong>factory that receives its dependencies</strong>, so a test can pass fakes and never opens a port or a database connection. Then use <code>supertest</code> to call it.</p><p class="codelabel">An app that takes its dependencies</p><pre>// app.mjs
export function createApp({ users, orders }) {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json());

  app.get('/users/:id', async (req, res, next) => {
    try {
      const user = await users.findById(req.params.id);
      if (!user) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'not found' });
      res.json(user);
    } catch (err) { next(err); }
  });

  app.use((err, _req, res, _next) => { res.status(500).json({ error: 'internal error' }); });   // never leak err.message
  return app;
}</pre><p class="codelabel">supertest against the app (both pass, no server listening)</p><pre>import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import request from 'supertest';
import { createApp } from './app.mjs';

const fakeUsers = { findById: async (id) => (id === '1' ? { id: '1', name: 'Ada' } : null) };
const fakeOrders = { create: async (o) => ({ id: 'o-1', ...o }) };

test('GET /users/:id returns the user', async () => {
  const res = await request(createApp({ users: fakeUsers, orders: fakeOrders })).get('/users/1');
  assert.equal(res.status, 200);
  assert.deepEqual(res.body, { id: '1', name: 'Ada' });
});

test('GET /users/:id returns 404 for a missing user', async () => {
  const res = await request(createApp({ users: fakeUsers, orders: fakeOrders })).get('/users/999');
  assert.equal(res.status, 404);
  assert.deepEqual(res.body, { error: 'not found' });
});</pre><ul><li>The same shape works with Fastify (<code>app.inject</code>) and NestJS (<code>Test.createTestingModule</code>).</li><li>Test each route for success, validation failure, unauthenticated, forbidden, not found and conflict.</li></ul>`

      q:"Fake the database or use a real one?",
      a:`<table class="cmp"><tr><th></th><th>Fake / in-memory</th><th>Real database in a container</th></tr><tr><td><strong>Speed</strong></td><td>Milliseconds</td><td>Seconds to start; fast once running</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Confidence</strong></td><td>Tests your handler logic</td><td>Tests your SQL, constraints, transactions and migrations</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Use for</strong></td><td>Handlers and business rules</td><td>Repository and query code</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Risk</strong></td><td>A fake that behaves differently from the real thing</td><td>Slower suites, container setup</td></tr></table><ul><li><strong>Handler tests:</strong> pass a fake repository (as above) so they run in milliseconds.</li><li><strong>Repository tests:</strong> run against the same database engine you use in production, in a throwaway container (for example with Testcontainers), because a fake cannot prove a unique constraint or an index.</li><li><strong>Isolation:</strong> wrap each test in a transaction and roll it back, or truncate tables between tests.</li></ul><p><strong>Trap:</strong> SQLite standing in for PostgreSQL passes tests and fails in production on types, locking and SQL differences. const fcEl = document.getElementById('fc');
const fc = { open:false, deck:[], i:0, revealed:false, got:0, missed:[], again:new Map(), title:'', source:[] };
function shuffleArr(a){ for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){ const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1)); const t=a[i]; a[i]=a[j]; a[j]=t; } return a; }
function startDeck(entries, title){
  if(!entries.length) return;
  fc.source = entries.slice();
  fc.deck = prefs.shuffle ? shuffleArr(entries.slice()) : entries.slice();
  fc.i = 0; fc.revealed = false; fc.got = 0; fc.missed = []; fc.again = new Map(); fc.title = title; fc.open = true;
  fc.opener = document.activeElement;   // restore focus here when the dialog closes
  fcEl.querySelector('#fcShuffle').checked = !!prefs.shuffle;
  fcEl.hidden = false; document.body.classList.add('fc-lock');
  renderFc();
  fcEl.querySelector('.fc-dialog').focus();
}
function closeFc(){
  fc.open = false; fcEl.hidden = true; document.body.classList.remove('fc-lock');
  refreshWeakButton();
  const opener = fc.opener; fc.opener = null;
  if(searchTerm) renderSearch(); else renderContent();   // rebuilds #content, so `opener` may now be a detached node
  // Return focus to whatever opened the deck when it's still on the page (the hero "Flashcards"
  // buttons, outside #content, always survive this). Otherwise #content was just rebuilt under
  // the (now-detached) opener, so land on its heading instead of silently losing focus to <body>.
  if(opener && document.contains(opener)) opener.focus();
  else {
    const heading = content.querySelector('.section-head h2') || content.querySelector('.section-head');
    if(heading){ heading.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1'); heading.focus(); }
  }
}
function markReviewed(key, val){ reviewed[key] = val; writeJSON(STORAGE_KEY, reviewed); const p = key.split(':'); syncTitle(p[0], Number(p[1]), val); updateProgress(); renderNav(); }
function renderFc(){
  const n = fc.deck.length;
  fcEl.querySelector('.fc-title').textContent = fc.title;
  fcEl.querySelector('.fc-count').textContent = (fc.i < n ? (fc.i + 1) : n) + ' / ' + n + (fc.got ? ' · ' + fc.got + ' got it' : '') + (fc.missed.length ? ' · ' + new Set(fc.missed).size + ' to revisit' : '');
  fcEl.querySelector('.fc-bar i').style.width = (n ? fc.i / n * 100 : 0) + '%';
  const body = fcEl.querySelector('.fc-body');
  const actions = fcEl.querySelector('.fc-actions');
  if(fc.i >= n){
    const uniqMissed = Array.from(new Set(fc.missed));
    body.innerHTML = '<div class="fc-done"><h3>Deck finished</h3><p>' + fc.got + ' marked "got it" (and ticked as reviewed) · ' + uniqMissed.length + ' to revisit.</p>' +
      (uniqMissed.length ? '<p class="fc-sub">To revisit:</p><ul>' + uniqMissed.map(e=>'<li>' + e.item.q + '</li>').join('') + '</ul>' : '<p class="fc-sub">Nothing missed. Well done.</p>') + '</div>';
    actions.innerHTML = (uniqMissed.length ? '<button data-fc="missed" class="primary">Practise the ' + uniqMissed.length + ' missed</button>' : '') +
      '<button data-fc="restart">Restart deck</button><button data-fc="close">Close <kbd>Esc</kbd></button>';
    return;
  }
  const e = fc.deck[fc.i];
  const key = qKey(e.section.id, e.qIdx);
  body.innerHTML = '<div class="qchips"><span class="qsec">' + e.section.title + '</span>' + (CORE.has(key) ? '<span class="qcore">★ core</span>' : '') + (reviewed[key] ? '<span class="qsec">reviewed</span>' : '') + '</div>' +
    '<h3 class="fc-q">' + e.item.q + '</h3>' +
    (fc.revealed ? '<div class="qbody fc-a">' + e.item.a + '</div>' : '<p class="fc-prompt">Answer it out loud first: the main point, one example, one trade-off. Then reveal.</p>');
  enhance(body);
  body.scrollTop = 0;
  actions.innerHTML = fc.revealed
    ? '<button data-fc="prev" title="Previous (←)">←</button><button data-fc="again" class="again">Again <kbd>1</kbd></button><button data-fc="got" class="primary">Got it <kbd>2</kbd></button>'
    : '<button data-fc="prev" title="Previous (←)">←</button><button data-fc="reveal" class="primary">Reveal answer <kbd>Space</kbd></button><button data-fc="skip">Skip <kbd>→</kbd></button>';
}
function fcAction(act){
  const n = fc.deck.length, e = fc.deck[fc.i];
  if(act === 'close') return closeFc();
  if(act === 'restart') return startDeck(fc.source, fc.title);
  if(act === 'missed') return startDeck(Array.from(new Set(fc.missed)), fc.title + ' · missed');
  if(fc.i >= n && act !== 'prev') return;
  if(act === 'reveal'){ fc.revealed = !fc.revealed; }
  else if(act === 'got'){ if(!fc.revealed){ fc.revealed = true; } else { markReviewed(qKey(e.section.id, e.qIdx), true); markWeak(e.tkey, false); fc.got++; fc.i++; fc.revealed = false; } }
  else if(act === 'again'){
    if(!fc.revealed){ fc.revealed = true; }
    else {
      const k = qKey(e.section.id, e.qIdx), times = fc.again.get(k) || 0;
      fc.missed.push(e);
      markWeak(e.tkey, true);
      if(times < 2){ fc.deck.push(e); fc.again.set(k, times + 1); }   // comes back later in this session
      fc.i++; fc.revealed = false;
    }
  }
  else if(act === 'skip'){ fc.i++; fc.revealed = false; }
  else if(act === 'prev'){ if(fc.i > 0){ fc.i--; fc.revealed = false; } }
  renderFc();
}
fcEl.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
  if(e.target === fcEl) return closeFc();
  const b = e.target.closest('button[data-fc]');
  if(b) return fcAction(b.dataset.fc);
  const a = e.target.closest('a[data-go]');
  if(a){ e.preventDefault(); closeFc(); const p = a.dataset.go.split(':'); gotoQuestion(p[0], Number(p[1]), true); }
});
fcEl.querySelector('#fcShuffle').addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
  prefs.shuffle = e.target.checked; savePrefs();
  const keep = fc.i + (fc.revealed ? 1 : 0);
  const rest = fc.deck.slice(keep);
  if(prefs.shuffle) shuffleArr(rest);
  fc.deck = fc.deck.slice(0, keep).concat(rest);
  renderFc();
});
function fcFocusables(){
  return Array.from(fcEl.querySelectorAll('button, input, a[href], [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])')).filter((el) => !el.disabled && el.offsetParent !== null);
}
function fcKey(e){
  if(e.key === 'Escape'){ e.preventDefault(); closeFc(); return; }
  if(e.key === 'Tab'){
    // trap focus inside the dialog: wrap from the last focusable back to the first, and vice versa
    const items = fcFocusables();
    if(!items.length) return;
    const idx = items.indexOf(document.activeElement);
    const next = e.shiftKey ? (idx <= 0 ? items.length - 1 : idx - 1) : (idx === items.length - 1 ? 0 : idx + 1);
    e.preventDefault();
    items[next].focus();
    return;
  }
  if(e.target && e.target.id === 'fcShuffle') return;
  const map = { ' ':'reveal', 'Enter':'reveal', '1':'again', '2':'got', 'ArrowRight':'skip', 'ArrowLeft':'prev' };
  const act = map[e.key];
  if(!act) return;
  if(e.target && e.target.tagName === 'BUTTON' && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) return;   // let a focused button click itself
  e.preventDefault();
  if(fc.i >= fc.deck.length && act !== 'prev') return;
  fcAction(act);
}
function deckFromView(){ return cards().map(c=> entry(c.dataset.sec, Number(c.dataset.q))); }
document.getElementById('fcCore').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  if(CORE.size) startDeck(Array.from(CORE).map(k=>{ const p = k.split(':'); return entry(p[0], Number(p[1])); }).filter(Boolean), 'All ★ core questions');
  else startDeck(INDEX.filter(e=>e.section.id!=='quickref'), 'All questions');
});

// ---- weak cards: any card marked "Again" (anywhere, including another guide), still unresolved
const fcWeakBtn = document.getElementById('fcWeak');
function weakOnThisGuide(){ return INDEX.filter(e=> weak[e.tkey]); }
function refreshWeakButton(){
  if(!fcWeakBtn) return;
  const n = weakOnThisGuide().length;
  fcWeakBtn.hidden = n === 0;
  fcWeakBtn.textContent = '↻ Review ' + n + ' weak card' + (n===1?'':'s');
}
function startWeakDeck(){
  if(fc.open) return;   // the #weak deep link retries its message for a few seconds; ignore repeats once the deck is open, or every retry would reset the user's progress in it
  const list = weakOnThisGuide();
  if(list.length) startDeck(list, 'Weak cards');
}
if(fcWeakBtn) fcWeakBtn.addEventListener('click', startWeakDeck);
refreshWeakButton();
window.addEventListener('storage', (e)=>{ if(e.key === WEAK_KEY){ weak = readJSON(WEAK_KEY, {}); refreshWeakButton(); } });

document.getElementById('resetBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  if(!confirm('Clear all reviewed checkmarks?')) return;
  reviewed = {}; writeJSON(STORAGE_KEY, reviewed);
  INDEX.forEach(e=>{ delete titleDone[e.tkey]; }); writeJSON(TITLES_KEY, titleDone);
  renderNav(); renderContent(); updateProgress();
});

document.getElementById('heroMeta').textContent = DATA.length + ' sections · ' + totalQuestions() + ' questions' + (CORE.size ? ' · ' + CORE.size + ' marked ★ core (linked from ' + window.__STUDY__.core + ')' : '');
document.getElementById('fcCore').textContent = CORE.size ? '▶ Flashcards: all ★ core questions' : '▶ Flashcards: all ' + INDEX.filter(e=>e.section.id!=='quickref').length + ' questions';
renderNav();
renderContent();
updateProgress();
</script>
